+def make_context(cafile=None, cadata=None, ciphers=None, validate_certs=True):
+    """Build a TLS context, optionally restricting the OpenSSL cipher list."""
+    if ciphers is not None:
+        if isinstance(ciphers, string_types):
+            cipher_string = ciphers
+        elif isinstance(ciphers, (list, tuple)) and ciphers and all(isinstance(cipher, string_types) and cipher for cipher in ciphers):
+            cipher_string = ':'.join(ciphers)
+        else:
+            raise ValueError('ciphers must be a non-empty OpenSSL cipher string or a non-empty list of cipher strings')
+        if not cipher_string:
+            raise ValueError('ciphers must be a non-empty OpenSSL cipher string or a non-empty list of cipher strings')
+
+    if HAS_SSLCONTEXT:
+        if validate_certs:
+            context = create_default_context(cafile=cafile)
+        else:
+            context = SSLContext(ssl.PROTOCOL_SSLv23)
+            if ssl.OP_NO_SSLv2:
+                context.options |= ssl.OP_NO_SSLv2
+            context.options |= ssl.OP_NO_SSLv3
+            context.check_hostname = False
+            context.verify_mode = ssl.CERT_NONE
+    elif HAS_URLLIB3_PYOPENSSLCONTEXT:
+        context = PyOpenSSLContext(PROTOCOL)
+        if not validate_certs:
+            context.verify_mode = ssl.CERT_NONE
+    else:
+        if ciphers is not None:
+            raise ValueError('Custom TLS ciphers require an SSL context implementation')
+        raise NotImplementedError('Host libraries are too old to support creating an sslcontext')
+
+    if validate_certs and (cafile or cadata):
+        context.load_verify_locations(cafile=cafile, cadata=cadata or None)
+    if ciphers is not None:
+        try:
+            context.set_ciphers(cipher_string)
+        except Exception:
+            raise ValueError('Invalid or unsupported TLS cipher configuration')
+    return context

diff --git a/test/units/module_utils/urls/test_ciphers.py b/test/units/module_utils/urls/test_ciphers.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..035fe2a
--- /dev/null
+++ b/test/units/module_utils/urls/test_ciphers.py
@@ -0,0 +1,98 @@
+from __future__ import absolute_import, division, print_function
+
+import ssl
+
+import pytest
+
+from ansible.module_utils.urls import (CustomHTTPSConnection, CustomHTTPSHandler, HTTPSClientAuthHandler,
+                                       Request, get_ca_certs, make_context)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('ciphers, expected', [
+    ('ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256:AES128-SHA', 'ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256:AES128-SHA'),
+    (['ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256', 'AES128-SHA'], 'ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256:AES128-SHA'),
+])
+def test_make_context_sets_ciphers(mocker, ciphers, expected):
+    context = mocker.patch('ansible.module_utils.urls.create_default_context').return_value
+    assert make_context(ciphers=ciphers) is context
+    context.set_ciphers.assert_called_once_with(expected)
+
+
+def test_make_context_preserves_default_validation(mocker):
+    create_context = mocker.patch('ansible.module_utils.urls.create_default_context')
+    make_context(ciphers=None)
+    create_context.assert_called_once_with(cafile=None)
+    create_context.return_value.set_ciphers.assert_not_called()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('ciphers', [[], '', [42], 42, 'NO_SUCH_CIPHER'])
+def test_make_context_rejects_invalid_ciphers(ciphers):
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match='ciphers|TLS cipher') as exc:
+        make_context(ciphers=ciphers)
+    assert 'NO_SUCH_CIPHER' not in str(exc.value)
+
+
+def test_make_context_without_cert_validation_rejects_old_ssl():
+    context = make_context(ciphers='DEFAULT', validate_certs=False)
+    assert context.verify_mode == ssl.CERT_NONE
+    assert not context.check_hostname
+    assert context.options & ssl.OP_NO_SSLv3
+    if ssl.OP_NO_SSLv2:
+        assert context.options & ssl.OP_NO_SSLv2
+
+
+def test_get_ca_certs_uses_explicit_file(tmp_path):
+    cert_path = tmp_path / 'ca.pem'
+    cert_path.write_text('')
+    path, cadata, checked = get_ca_certs(str(cert_path))
+    assert path == str(cert_path)
+    assert cadata == bytearray()
+    assert checked == [str(cert_path)]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('url, unix_socket', [
+    ('https://ansible.com/', None),
+    ('http://ansible.com/redirect', None),
+    ('https://ansible.com/', '/tmp/ansible-test.sock'),
+])
+def test_request_uses_cipher_context_for_https_redirect_and_unix(mocker, url, unix_socket):
+    mocker.patch('ansible.module_utils.urls.urllib_request.urlopen')
+    install_opener = mocker.patch('ansible.module_utils.urls.urllib_request.install_opener')
+    mocker.patch('ansible.module_utils.urls.get_ca_certs', return_value=(None, None, []))
+    context = mocker.patch('ansible.module_utils.urls.make_context').return_value
+
+    Request(ciphers=['ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256']).open('GET', url, unix_socket=unix_socket)
+
+    handlers = install_opener.call_args[0][0].handlers
+    https_handler = next(h for h in handlers if isinstance(h, CustomHTTPSHandler))
+    assert https_handler._context is context
+    if unix_socket:
+        client_handler = next(h for h in handlers if isinstance(h, HTTPSClientAuthHandler))
+        assert client_handler._context is context
+
+
+def test_https_proxy_tunnel_uses_configured_context(mocker):
+    context = mocker.Mock()
+    sock = mocker.patch('ansible.module_utils.urls.socket.create_connection').return_value
+    connection = CustomHTTPSConnection('proxy.example', context=context)
+    connection.set_tunnel('target.example')
+    mocker.patch.object(connection, '_tunnel')
+
+    connection.connect()
+
+    connection._tunnel.assert_called_once_with()
+    context.wrap_socket.assert_called_once_with(sock, server_hostname='target.example')
+
+
+def test_pyopenssl_context_is_used_for_unix_https(mocker):
+    mocker.patch('ansible.module_utils.urls.HAS_SSLCONTEXT', False)
+    mocker.patch('ansible.module_utils.urls.HAS_URLLIB3_PYOPENSSLCONTEXT', True)
+    context = mocker.patch('ansible.module_utils.urls.PyOpenSSLContext', create=True).return_value
+    assert make_context(ciphers=['ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256']) is context
+    context.set_ciphers.assert_called_once_with('ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256')
+
+    handler = HTTPSClientAuthHandler(custom_context=context, unix_socket='/tmp/ansible-test.sock')
+    connection = handler._build_https_connection('example.com')
+    assert isinstance(connection, CustomHTTPSConnection)
+    assert connection.context is context
+    assert connection._unix_socket == '/tmp/ansible-test.sock'
